title: An Agentic AI Framework with Large Language Models and Chain-of-Thought for UAV-Assisted Logistics Scheduling with Mobile Edge Computing
abstract: arXiv:2605.13221v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In cloud manufacturing, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can support both product collection and mobile edge computing (MEC). This joint operation forms a hybrid scheduling problem, where physical logistics decisions are coupled with computational task scheduling. In this paper, UAVs collect finished products from manufacturing stations and transport them back to a central depot. Meanwhile, computational tasks generated by industrial sensor devices at these stations are processed locally, at UAVs, or offloaded via UAVs to the cloud. This coupling makes the problem challenging. A UAV can provide MEC services only during its service window at a station, so routing decisions directly determine when UAV-assisted offloading is available. Routing decisions also affect the UAV energy budget and the availability of onboard computing and communication resources for computational task execution under task deadline constraints. translated_title: 一种结合大语言模型与思维链的智能体AI框架，用于无人机辅助物流调度与移动边缘计算
translated_abstract: 在云制造中，无人机（UAV）可以同时支持产品收集和移动边缘计算（MEC）。这种联合操作形成了一个混合调度问题，其中物理物流决策与计算任务调度相互耦合。本文中，无人机从制造站点收集成品并将其运回中央仓库。同时，这些站点上的工业传感器设备产生的计算任务在本地处理、在无人机上处理，或通过无人机卸载到云端。这种耦合使问题具有挑战性。无人机只能在站点的服务窗口内提供MEC服务，因此路由决策直接决定了无人机辅助卸载何时可用。路由决策还影响无人机的能量预算以及机载计算和通信资源在任务截止期限约束下的可用性。为解决这一问题，本文提出了一种智能体AI框架，结合大语言模型与思维链来优化无人机辅助物流调度和边缘计算资源的联合分配。
tldr: 本文提出了一种结合大语言模型和思维链的智能体AI框架，用于解决无人机辅助物流调度与移动边缘计算的耦合优化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an agentic AI framework integrating large language models and chain-of-thought to address the coupled optimization of UAV-assisted logistics scheduling and mobile edge computing.
